[EN] , we’d like to have some words with you, in Velika. Dougal will be your guide.
— Gislan


[You must have equipment level 463 or higher to enter Antaroth’s Abyss.]
[ES] , nos gustaría hablar contigo en Velika. Dougal será tu guía.
— Gislan


[Debes tener un nivel de equipo de 463 o superior para entrar en Antaroth’s Abyss.]

[EN] Karakhir never reappeared after you rescued him, and you were accused of his murder by Aktam. You reluctantly headed for the Abyss to address the accusations.
[ES] Karakhir nunca reapareció después de que lo rescataste, y fuiste acusado de su asesinato por Aktam. Te dirigiste a regañadientes al Abyss para responder a las acusaciones.

[EN] Greetings, .
Gislan has asked for you. Go to Velika immediately.
"Who is Gislan?"
[ES] Saludos, .
Gislan ha preguntado por ti. Ve a Velika inmediatamente.
"Who is Gislan?"

[EN] Gislan oversees the security and operations of Velika itself. After the war, he was instrumental in transforming Velika into the capital of the Valkyon Federation.

It's not surprising that you don't recognize his name, as he rarely makes public appearances.

In fact, I don't recall him ever calling someone for a personal audience.
Odd."Why is he looking for me?"
[ES] Gislan supervisa la seguridad y las operaciones de la propia Velika. Tras la guerra, fue fundamental para transformar Velika en la capital de la Valkyon Federation.

No es de extrañar que no reconozcas su nombre, ya que rara vez hace apariciones públicas.

De hecho, no recuerdo que jamás haya llamado a nadie para una audiencia personal.
Extraño."Why is he looking for me?"

[EN] I don't have any more details for you, sorry.
But Gislan handles matters far above my rank. It's best not to keep him waiting.
[ES] No tengo más detalles para ti, lo siento.
Pero Gislan maneja asuntos que están muy por encima de mi rango. Es mejor no hacerlo esperar.

[EN] , I won't waste time. You stand accused of high treason.

Aktam here has testified that you are a high-ranking officer in the Red Raiders.

He claims not only that you kidnapped his master Karakhir to forge weapons for the Red Raiders, but that your previous service to the federation was all a ruse to destroy us from within.

How do you answer these very serious charges?
[ES] , no perderé el tiempo. Se te acusa de alta traición.

Aktam aquí presente ha testificado que eres un oficial de alto rango en los Red Raiders.

Afirma no solo que secuestraste a su maestro Karakhir para forjar armas para los Red Raiders, sino que tu servicio anterior a la federación fue solo una farsa para destruirnos desde dentro.

¿Cómo respondes a estos cargos tan graves?

[EN] You monster! First you abducted Master Karakhir, then you tortured him and made up a story about helping him escape. But where is he then? He would have contacted me or his father if he was alive!

Look, you've even got his horn! Lord Gislan, what more proof do you need of the master's murder!
[ES] ¡Monstruo! ¡Primero secuestraste al maestro Karakhir, luego lo torturaste y te inventaste una historia sobre ayudarlo a escapar. Pero, ¿dónde está entonces? ¡Se habría comunicado conmigo o con su padre si estuviera vivo!

¡Mira, hasta tienes su cuerno! ¡Lord Gislan, qué más prueba necesita del asesinato del maestro!

[EN] , these charges are serious, and if this horn was indeed Karakhir's, you have much to answer for. But only you and Aktam were present at the Red Raiders' camp, and one of you must be lying.

Tell me now, are you plotting against the goddess Velik? Did you abduct Karakhir, and try to attack the federation?
[ES] , estos cargos son graves, y si este cuerno era en verdad de Karakhir, tienes mucho que explicar. Pero solo tú y Aktam estaban presentes en el campamento de los Red Raiders, y uno de ustedes debe estar mintiendo.

Dime ahora, ¿estás conspirando contra la diosa Velik? ¿Secuestraste a Karakhir e intentaste atacar a la federación?

[EN] Tread lightly. The punishment for treason is severe.
[ES] Pisa con cuidado. El castigo por traición es severo.

[EN] No one can confirm your story. Both Aktam and Dougal saw you emerge from the Red Raiders' encampment showing signs of a fight, and you are in posession of a broken amani horn.
We are a society of laws, but people as powerful as yourself are rarely held accountable for their actions. If you are truly innocent, there is but one way to prove it.

Enter the Abyss, make your way to the Chamber of Trials, and face Antaroth, the Cursed Knight.
Only the pure of heart can survive such an encounter. If you come through alive, I will believe you are truly innocent.

If you fail...
[ES] Nadie puede confirmar tu historia. Tanto Aktam como Dougal te vieron salir del campamento de los Red Raiders mostrando signos de una pelea, y estás en posesión de un cuerno de amani roto.
Somos una sociedad de leyes, pero a las personas tan poderosas como tú rara vez se les piden cuentas por sus acciones. Si eres verdaderamente inocente, solo hay una forma de demostrarlo.

Entra al Abyss, ábrete paso hasta la Chamber of Trials y enfréntate a Antaroth, el caballero maldito.
Solo los de corazón puro pueden sobrevivir a un encuentro así. Si sales con vida, creeré que eres verdaderamente inocente.

Si fallas...

[EN] Now is not the best time...
You must go to the Velika Consul Office."Do you suspect me, too?"
[ES] Ahora no es el mejor momento...
Debes ir a la Velika Consul Office."Do you suspect me, too?"

[EN] You were the last one who saw Karakhir.
And you have his horn.
Those are the facts.

I don't know what happened, but if you have something to confess, you should do it now.
[ES] Fuiste el último en ver a Karakhir.
Y tienes su cuerno.
Esos son los hechos.

No sé qué pasó, pero si tienes algo que confesar, deberías hacerlo ahora.

[EN] You have validated my trust, .
Still, there are others who will suspect your true motives.

Continue your efforts against the Red Raiders, and I will look further into this matter.
[ES] Has validado mi confianza, .
Aun así, hay otros que sospecharán de tus verdaderas intenciones.

Continúa tus esfuerzos contra los Red Raiders, y investigaré más a fondo este asunto.
